meta.era_order: data/periods.json, consecutive eras in the same stream sorted by start, end (same as db/legends what_changed)
meta.rules: Pairs only live db/extents polygons; no new geometry. Each from-polygon is paired with the next-era polygon of highest overlap (IoU). mode: hold (identical), morph (IoU >= 0.3), cross_fade (overlap but IoU < 0.3). Non-overlapping shapes go to fade_out / fade_in. shared_edge_km_approx and changed_sides are display aids computed from the two live geometries (bbox side deltas), not sourced limits.
meta.overlay_maps_file: db/border_overlay_maps.json (maps listed in db/map_sources.json checked_against per shape)

exclusions.note: WP_MAKURIA and WP_MAKURIA_2026 (same Wikipedia Makuria article) excluded from mamluk-sultanate transition cites: the Makuria post-1276 reach (Lower Nubia to Kordofan under Siti) and the Abu Hamad anchor are unsourced and removed. The OHM Mamluk polygons are reference only; they stop at c.19.9N and do not draw the Makuria reach, so no pair or shape part depended on it and geometry is unchanged. Makuria 1276-1364 vassalage and cession of provinces: VERIFY (no accepted source yet), with no drawn limit.
